smoke.line: Smile on my face, but it's really no joke
smoke.linePrev: Sometimes I try to chill, mellow down, blowin' smoke
smoke.lineNext: You feel it in the street, the people breathe without hope

smoke.line: Last year, this time, wasn't no joke
stanza: Last year, this time, wasn't no joke
My whole barn went up in smoke
My horse jethro, well he went mad
And I can't remember things bein' so bad
Then there comes a man with a paper and a pen
Tellin' us our hard times are about to end
And then, if they don't give us what we like
He said, "men, that's when you gotta go on strike."
